name: Git
title: Git-2.55.0
summary: Git is a free and open source, distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency. Every Git clone is a full-fledged repository with complete history and full revision tracking capabilities, not dependent on network access or a central server. Branching and merging are fast and easy to do. Git is used for version control of files, much like tools such as mercurial-7.2.4 , Bazaar , Subversion-1.14.5 , CVS , Perforce , and Team Foundation Server .
